notes.title: A post regarding Kenophobia's future
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I hope you all are doing well!

First of all, it's been a while since I've posted any anouncements. Sorry about that!
Anyways, I have something significant to say about the game's future. To begin with, no, I'm [b]not [/b]abandoning the game! Don't worry! Now, I've taken a bit of time to think about the game's current state (like performance and level design, with only a few to mention), and I have come to the conclusion that I will be rebuilding the game from scratch.

The original version (or, as of me posting this announcement, Kenophobia Legacy) was built using Unity, with the use of the HDRP (High Definition Render Pipeline). What that means is the game had much better graphical capabilities out of the box. However, this also meant that performance would be limited, and with every update, the performance would worsen. Another thing that I wasn't particularly proud of was the game mechanics - they weren't designed very well, and thus resulted in various bugs (like the inventory system bug, where it wouldn't close properly, or the camera would zoom unintentionally). The level design also wasn't great - the majority of the levels lacked details, atmosphere and interaction. I've decided that instead of trying to fix the issues in the legacy version, which would be extremely time-consuming, the best solution would be a full rebuild, one that will become what the game was originally meant to be, and one that will improve everything you all know about the game.

[h1]What will change?[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game will utilize URP (Universal Render Pipeline), a lighter and more optimized renderer, ensuring better performance without sacrificing visual quality.
[*] Gameplay mechanics will be rebuilt, and will provide a significantly better and less buggy experience.
[*] There will be a public beta branch for the game, allowing players to test upcoming builds and help minimize bugs before the official release.
[*] Support for more platforms, not just Windows.
[*] Overhauled level design.
[/list]
...and a lot more! This update won’t be easy to make, and will likely take a lot of time. However, this will be a fresh start for the game, that will make it into what it was meant to be from the very beginning. I'll be sure to share more details as development progresses.
Now, you might be wondering if the legacy version will be replaced - I've decided that I will keep the legacy version. It will most likely be moved to its own, designated branch. It will most likely not be maintained, or it won't include the changes mentioned above.
With that said, if you have any questions regarding the game, please do not hesitate to join the [url=discord.gg/invite/5UkVUMVvmE]official Discord server[/url], where I'll do my best to answer them!
Take care, and stay tuned!

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Hey guys!
Finally, after a few months of work, the update has been released! 
As mentioned earlier, this update is huge, ranging from expanded levels and more items to QoL features and bug fixes!

Here is a list of everything included in the update:


[b]ADDED:[/b]

[*] added bob
[*] added more inventory items
[*] added support for Full HD and Quad HD resolution
[*] added animations for when interacting with objects, such as the flashlight
[*] you can now use the scroll wheel to swap items in the hotbar, not just the number keys
[*] added a battery system to the flashlight. The player will now be required to look for batteries so that the flashlight can be used.
[*] added in-game settings
[*] added cutscenes which will be played on some levels when the player enters them
[*] added a list of controls to The Lobby 
[*] added new levels:
[list]
[*] Shoprooms 2
- A sublevel of Shoprooms, featuring a long, pink corridor
[*] Stations
- A level resembling an underground railway station, featuring a store and restaurant, as well as an outer area.
[*] Fallen World
[*] Habitable Zone
- A level resembling an underground parking area, with wet concrete.
[*] Pool Heaven
- A level resembling a pool-like area, surrounded by an infinite ocean
[/list]

[*] added a help command to the laptop in level Management Hall
[*] the player can now zoom the camera in and out
[*] added a Medium graphics preset
[*] and… more…

[b]CHANGED:[/b]
[*] expanded levels (this includes but is not limited to more areas and some bug fixes):
[list]
[*] The Lobby
[*] Basement
[*] Sublimity
[*] Level 188
[*] Management Threshold
[*] Management Hall
[*] The Lobby 2
[*] Kitty’s House
[*] Shoprooms
[*] Run For Your Life
[*] THE END is NEaR
[*] True End
[/list]

[*] each level displays its name upon entering it
[*] The player is no longer required to press the buttons in Sublimity. Only finding the wrench is required as of this update
[*] made the game replayable by making some levels exclusive to certain exits. This means that some levels can have more than one exit, thus the possibility to end up in a different level
[*] changed some of the progression mechanics in some of the levels
[*] made some slight changes to the inventory UI
[*] improved reflection in the Shoprooms
[*] moved the console input from the laptop in level Management Hall to the bottom
[*] added some more buttons to the laptop in level Management Hall
[*] the credits section in the main menu now has a scrollbar
[*] slightly improved some models
[*] revamped the main menu UI
[*] revamped the pause menu UI
[*] changed some item textures
[*] optimized some levels
[*] changes under the hood

[b]FIXED:[/b]

[*] improved object interaction
[*] fixed an issue where footstep sounds would often repeat
[*] made the flashlight in Level 0 less bright
[*] fixed a rendering glitch in an area in Level 0
[*] fixed a noclip bug in level Sublimity
[*] fixed a bug involving function keys
[*] fixed some bugs related to interacting with the laptop in level Management Hall
[*] fixed an issue related to slight noclipping when too close to a wall
[*] fixed some issues related to driving the car in level Synth, like wrong rotations and inaccurate speed
[*] fixed an issue related to loading save data


[b]REMOVED:[/b]
[*] removed item swapping in the inventory due to numerous issues
[*] the position of the player is no longer saved and loaded. Only the level and inventory are saved


[b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b]
[*] some of the audio might not be fully muted when the volume is set to 0. This issue will be fixed in a later update!

Enjoy!
